items.title: 구찌와 머라이어 캐리가 완성한 눈부신 2026 홀리데이 풍경
items.summary: Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign features Mariah Carey wearing designs by creative director Demna, built around a butterfly motif tied to Carey's own iconography, and introducing the new Starlet handbag line (shoulder bag, Boston bag, bucket, tote). Carey later appeared at a Gucci private store event in New York handing out gifts while a choir performed her Christmas song. Pure activation/marketing coverage.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라… 제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다
items.summary: Actor Park Bo-gum, newly named Gucci global brand ambassador, and aespa's Ningning attended the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala as Gucci guests, drawing fashion-press coverage of their red-carpet looks. Activation/ambassador coverage.

items.title: 박보검, 구찌 글로벌 앰버서더 선정 "기쁘고 기대된다"[공식]
items.summary: Gucci officially named actor Park Bo-gum as its new global brand ambassador on November 5. Park said he was glad to write new stories atop Gucci's century of heritage and looks forward to understanding Demna's style language. Official activation announcement.

items.title: 박보검 구찌 오늘자 얼굴...jpg
items.summary: Korean community thread sharing photos of Park Bo-gum at the Gucci-sponsored LACMA gala; top visible comment reacts favorably to his looks. 35,220 views and 148 comments recorded on the thread, indicating solid organic fan engagement with the ambassador news rather than brand-driven messaging.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、关店105家、中国制造，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Chinese Weibo-syndicated explainer post summarizing Gucci's recent structural news: Demna's debut show, a net 105 store closures globally this year, and the brand's first "Made in China" sneaker line -- framed as evidence Gucci is shifting from near-top-luxury status to a lower tier of the first luxury group.

items.title: Gucci names Park Bo-gum global brand face
items.summary: Jing Daily reports Gucci's appointment of Korean actor Park Bo-gum as global brand ambassador, deepening ties with the star after prior Gucci appearances; he will take part in upcoming campaigns and events. Framed within broader China/NEA luxury-celebrity strategy coverage.

items.title: [미국 특징주] "명품보다 가성비" 중국 Z세대, 구찌 대신 코치 구매
items.summary: Critical-angle piece: Coach and Ralph Lauren sales in China jumped over 30% in the September quarter while LVMH and Kering brands (including Gucci) saw double-digit declines; Tapestry (Coach parent) posted 35% Greater China growth. Shanghai consumer quoted saying young Chinese no longer see luxury logos as a status symbol and now prioritize value for money over brands like Gucci.

items.title: 올해 브랜드 가치 '나이키' 36%, '구찌' 31% 하락
items.summary: Critical: Interbrand-style brand value rankings show Gucci's brand value fell 30.7% this year, compounding last year's 35% drop -- roughly a 55% two-year decline. Gucci's valuation fell from $11.6B to $8.1B and its overall rank among the top 100 brands dropped from 69th to 93rd.

items.title: 연말 시즌 앞두고 명품 가격 'N차 인상'···"한국만 배짱장사" 비판 확산
items.summary: Critical: Report on recurring year-end luxury price hikes in Korea, naming Gucci as having quietly raised prices in late October without notice (Marmont Mini Shoulder bag up 9.5%, from KRW 2.22M to 2.43M), alongside similar hikes at Bottega Veneta and Chanel. Industry critics call Korea a price-experiment "testing ground" versus stricter EU pricing oversight. Included despite being outside the strict 14-day window because the underlying Oct/Nov repricing pattern it documents continues to be cited in fresh Nov 2026 coverage (see item 010); retained as corroborating background only, weighted low.

items.title: 환율·금값 급등에…명품 N차 인상
items.summary: Background/trend piece (outside freshness window, kept only as context, not counted as a fresh signal) on Korean luxury brands including Gucci repeatedly raising prices in response to won depreciation and raw material costs -- the 'N-cha' (repeated hikes) pattern referenced by Nov 2026 reporting.

items.title: '명품도 명품 나름' 세계 리셀 시장 돈 되는 브랜드는 이것
items.summary: Critical: Resale-market report stating the secondhand value of Kering's top three brands -- Gucci, Balenciaga and Bottega Veneta -- has fallen 10%, 14% and 23% respectively over the past year, as pandemic-era speculative demand unwinds and owners offload high-end pieces for cash; analysts note aggressive brand price hikes have backfired on resale value.

items.title: 【2026年クリスマスコフレ】「グッチ ビューティ」は"レオナルド モチーフ"の限定リップや香水セットなどを発売
items.summary: Trade coverage of Gucci Beauty's 2026 holiday coffret line (Leonardo-motif lipsticks, fragrance gift sets) launching November 4 in Japan. Standard activation/product coverage.

items.title: グッチ"シルバーロゴ"のレザートートバッグ＆犬モチーフのコインケース、伊勢丹新宿店で
items.summary: Japanese fashion trade outlet covers a limited-run Gucci silver-logo leather tote and dog-motif coin case sold at a pop-up inside Isetan Shinjuku, part of a Japan-exclusive capsule running into mid-November. Standard retail/activation coverage.

items.title: 「パクボゴムに、グッチを着て"世紀の悪役"を演じてほしい」ファッション業界の関係者投稿が話題
items.summary: A Japanese K-drama fan blog aggregating an Instagram-story comment from a fashion-industry insider wishing to see Park Bo-gum play a dramatic "villain" role while wearing Gucci; Korean fans reportedly echoed the sentiment. Organic fan/SNS chatter riding the ambassador announcement, not brand-issued.

items.title: グッチの「底打ち」に、中国が待ったをかけた。仏高級ブランド株は11%沈む
items.summary: Critical: Report that hopes of a Gucci sales "bottoming out" were derailed by continued weak China demand, triggering an 11% drop in French luxury stocks including Kering. China directly operated store sales reportedly fell further, undercutting turnaround narratives built around Demna's relaunch.

items.source: The Paper (澎湃新闻, via m.thepaper.cn)
items.title: 古驰再闭店，高端消费品越来越难了？
items.summary: Background (outside freshness window, kept only to corroborate ongoing closure trend): Chinese financial-news report on Gucci's continued store closures in China (including the Wuhan Henglong Plaza location), tying the retreat to a broader high-end consumption slowdown and Gucci's shrinking footprint plan toward 2030.

items.title: Demna's Gucci Appointment Receives Lukewarm Response from Fashion Industry and Stock Holders
items.summary: Background only (outside freshness window): documents the originally lukewarm fashion-industry and investor reaction to Demna's Gucci appointment, with Kering stock dropping 12.7% at the time. Retained purely as historical context for ongoing Demna-era skepticism narratives still being cited.

items.title: Park Bo-gum named Gucci global brand ambassador
items.summary: English-language Korean T1 daily reports Park Bo-gum's appointment as Gucci's new global brand ambassador, noting his prior Gucci-related appearances and the significance for Gucci's Korea/APAC star-marketing strategy.
